name: Teramitsu Haruhi
source:
He is the complete opposite of his twin brother, Yuzuki, and is a bright and conspicuous person. He has clear emotions and, although he is honest and hateful. With a complicated upbringing, he lived with Yuzuki in an orphanage before beginning training.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#teramitsuharuhi]official website[/url]]
